The thing about the obviousness part of patents that gets me. If your the first person to come up with it by combining multiple other elements, how is it obviousness if no one else before you every combined it all? If it was obvious wouldn't the exact invention already exist? Also if do it differently than how abc and d goes together, then how can it be obvious. 

The way it seems to me, the way this is, an examiner could say unless you invented every part that never existed before. They could find prior art on everything you used to make said invention. Screws, bearing, springs, steel,  plastics, seems like it could be a lil out of control.
